title: Characteristics and Design Parameters of Activated Sludge Systems for Sewage
markdown:
| Process Type | unit | Conventional | Complete mix | Extended aeration |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MLSS | mg/L | 1500 to 3000 | 3000 to 4000 | 3000 to 5000 |
| MLSS/MLVSS | ratio | 0.8 | 0.8 | 0.6 |
| F/M | day⁻¹ | 0.3 to 0.4 | 0.3 to 0.6 | 0.1 to 0.18 |
| HRT | Hours | 4 to 6 | 4 to 6 | 12 to 24 |
| θc | days | 5 to 8 | 5 to 8 | 10 to 26 |
| Q_R/Q | ratio | 0.25 to 0.5 | 0.25 to 0.8 | 0.25 to 1.0 |
| BOD removal | % | 85 to 92 | 85 to 92 | 95 to 98 |
| kg O₂/kg BOD removed | ratio | 0.8 to 1.0 | 0.8 to 1.0 | 1.0 to 1.2 |
notes: Printed group heading "Flow Regime" spans the Conventional, Complete mix and Extended aeration columns above them; it is recorded here as a note because the header grid keeps the three flow regimes as columns.
Printed θc without a subscript and QR/Q with a subscript R; reproduced as printed.

transcription.method: direct visual reading of 144 dpi annotation-cleaned full-page renders plus 288-900 dpi crops of the source regions; no OCR
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every value, exponent, subscript, printed spelling and printed error was read from the rendered page image. No distinct second inspection performed; record is a draft pending review.
